ops.parking: There is a free parking lot for users of the facilities. Use the Gaien exit of the Shuto Expressway Route 4 (the exit differs for the inbound and outbound lines). It is very crowded on Saturdays, Sundays and holidays. (Source: https://www.meijikinenkan.gr.jp/info/floor.html)
ops.restaurants: On site are Hagoromo (sushi, tempura and teppanyaki), Hanagasumi (kaiseki restaurant; 7 private rooms for 2 to 48 guests) and Kinkei (lounge / dining). The beer terrace Sekirei has ended its operation for fiscal 2026. (Source: https://www.meijikinenkan.gr.jp/restaurant/)
